item.title: WordPress Page Editing Tutorial
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | My WordPress site is live and healthy, but I’m stuck on one simple thing—editing the content. I’d like a step-by-step lesson focused specifically on updating pages and text. The site was set up with a page builder (Elementor or possibly WPBakery—whichever is active), so the training needs to happen inside that interface rather than the default block editor.
Here’s what I’m aiming for: • A real-time screen-share session where you walk me through locating a page in the builder, changing text, saving, and publishing. • Clear explanations of best practices—avoiding layout breaks, keeping headings consistent, and rolling back changes if something goes wrong. • A concise cheat sheet or short video recap so I can repeat the steps on my own afterward.
No code changes or design work are required; the entire scope is knowledge-transfer. Once I understand how to edit pages and text confidently, the job is complete.

item.title: Finalize Educational Course Funnel
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | My site for first-time learners is almost ready, but the flow from initial visit to course purchase still feels disjointed. I need a funnel specialist to connect the dots so a beginner lands on the page, downloads a free guide or checklist, and is then guided smoothly toward buying the full course.
Most pages, assets, and copy are in place. Your job is to audit the existing structure, tighten the sequence, and implement any missing pieces—opt-in form, automated email follow-ups, sales page refinements, checkout setup, analytics, and simple A/B tests where they make sense. I’m open to your recommendations on tools (WordPress plugins, ClickFunnels, Kajabi, ConvertKit, etc.) as long as the handoff is clean and I can manage updates later.
Success for this project means: • The lead magnet is delivered instantly and reliably. • Email nurturing flows lead new subscribers to the sales page without gaps. • The purchase path is friction-free on desktop and mobile, with clear metrics tracking each step.
If you excel at turning educational content into a high-converting funnel and can move quickly while communicating clearly, let’s wrap this up together.

item.title: Website Paid Tier Flow Finalization
item.description:
30-250 USD | My site already presents three paid membership options, but the flow that guides a visitor from first click to correct tier completion still needs a professional hand. The intention behind these levels is clear: offer different service packages or support levels, with distinctions rooted mainly in the level of personal guidance or access each member receives. What I lack is a crisp, documented path that makes the upgrade, downgrade, and fulfillment process seamless for users and effortless for my developers to implement.
You will start by auditing the current screens, copy, and backend logic, spotting anything that could confuse a customer or break in production. From there I want a concise, practical roadmap that covers:
• A tier-by-tier matrix outlining entitlements, support response expectations, and gating rules • An annotated user-journey flowchart that shows every decision point from sign-up to upgrade/cancellation • Clear functional requirements (or user stories) the dev team can drop straight into Jira or Trello • Implementation notes on payment gateway hooks, CRM tagging, and analytics tracking so we can measure conversions per tier
I’m happy with Figma, Miro, Lucidchart, or similar tools—choose whichever you prefer as long as the hand-off files remain editable. The deliverable is accepted once the flow has no loose ends, the documentation anticipates edge cases, and the tiers feel self-explanatory when we walk through them together via screen-share.
If refining membership experiences and translating business goals into developer-ready specs is second nature to you, this should be a straightforward, high-impact engagement.

item.title: Bold Colourful Website Revamp -- 2
item.description:
100-300 USD | My website needs a complete visual refresh that instantly grabs attention and feels vibrant, modern, and exciting. The redesign should embrace a bold, colourful look while keeping the user experience smooth and intuitive.
Scope of work • Re-imagine the homepage and each main service page so they look fresh, engaging, and conversion-focused. • Improve layout, typography, imagery, and colour choices to reflect an energetic brand personality. • Ensure every key section (hero area, service highlights, testimonials, calls-to-action) guides visitors naturally toward an enquiry or purchase. • Deliver responsive designs that load fast and display perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Deliverables 1. High-fidelity mock-ups or prototypes for the homepage and all main service pages. 2. Final web-ready assets (CSS, images, icons, or theme files) ready for hand-off or direct implementation. 3. Style guide summarising colour palette, fonts, and UI components for future consistency.
Acceptance criteria • Visual style clearly reflects a “bold and colourful” aesthetic. • Each redesigned page passes mobile-friendly testing tools and core web vitals. • CTAs are prominently placed and function correctly on live pages.
Please share a few examples of similarly vibrant sites you have designed and outline the tools you prefer to build or hand-off (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD, WordPress, Webflow, custom HTML/CSS). I’m ready to get started as soon as I find the right creative partner.

I’m open on platforms—whether you prefer ClickFunnels, Leadpages, WordPress + WooCommerce, or a clean HTML page hooked to Stripe—so long as the end result is fast, mobile-friendly and ready to scale.
My website is built in Squarespace and my chap configurator in lovable AI
. If you have past funnels that jumped directly from opt-in to paid offer, share those links or screenshots in your reply; that track record will weigh heavily in my selection.

Let’s get this funnel converting.

item.title: Long-Term WordPress Maintenance
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | My WordPress site needs steady, knowledgeable attention so it stays secure, fast, and problem-free day after day. The ongoing workload centres on three areas:
• Plugins, backups, and security – keeping every component updated on a staging copy first, scheduling reliable off-site backups, running regular scans, and hardening the install against new threats. • Performance tuning – analysing load times, refining caching and image optimisation, and tracking the results so we see clear speed gains. • General site management – jumping in quickly when an error appears, tidying small layout glitches, and handling the occasional content tweak.
This is a long-term arrangement rather than a single overhaul. Consistent weekly maintenance, clear communication, and a proactive mindset are essential. Familiarity with typical WordPress tooling (cPanel, phpMyAdmin, Cloudflare, popular optimisation and security plugins) will make the work straightforward.
Deliverables the first month: 1. Safe update process documented and running on a schedule 2. Automated daily backups verified and stored off-site 3. Security scan with issues resolved or documented 4. Baseline performance report with an action plan for improvements
Ongoing: the same checks each month, rapid fixes within 24 hours when something breaks, and a brief monthly summary of work completed.
If this fits your expertise and you’re available for consistent weekly / monthly touch-points, I’d like to hear how you normally structure maintenance and monitoring.

item.title: Build Tailwind Website for Compliance Firm
item.description:
250-750 GBP | Web Development: Interactive Forensic-Style Tailwind & Netlify Site for Housing Compliance Firm
We are seeking an expert front-end developer to build a fast, high-converting, responsive website for Chauntry Housing Compliance Ltd, an independent damp, mould, and ventilation diagnostic surveying firm based in Berkshire.
Design & Architectural Concept:
Style: Inspired by high-end investigative and forensic case file layouts (clean, data-driven, highly engaging, moving away from generic corporate templates in favor of an evidence-led, technical presentation). UI & Visual Layout: Structured case files, expandable field notes, clean property cutaways mapping damp types, categorized evidence logs for mould species, and professional high-contrast typography built natively with Tailwind CSS.
Technical & Structural Requirements:
Tech Stack: Modern front-end using Tailwind CSS. Must be lightweight, fully responsive, and deployed on Netlify with GitHub repository integration.
SEO & Metadata: Custom LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema, clean meta descriptions, and localized structure targeting Berkshire, Oxfordshire, and Buckinghamshire (RG, SL, OX, HP postcodes).
Service & Pricing Presentation: Prominent, side-by-side presentation of our 3-tier diagnostic pricing structure (£99 initial triage, modular diagnostic add-ons, and comprehensive survey packages) with direct-to-action booking CTA anchors embedded throughout.
Regulatory Focus: Dedicated sections covering Awaab’s Law statutory timeframes, HHSRS Category 1 hazard evaluations, and Part F ventilation compliance.
Independent Model Framing: Unavoidable messaging confirming our strict independent model (diagnostics and technical reporting only; zero remedial or repair works undertaken).
Site Architecture: Home, About Us, Diagnostic Menu & Pricing, Regulatory Standards, and Contact / Direct Booking.
Project & Security Terms:
Strict On-Platform Rule: All messaging, project updates, and milestone payments must take place 100% on-platform. Requests for external messaging (WhatsApp/Telegram/email) prior to contract execution will result in instant bid disqualification.
Access Scope: Code base delivered via GitHub repository. No remote desktop or direct local device access will be granted.

item.title: Full-Stack Web Developer Required – Modern Website Development & Platform Integration
item.description:
750-1500 GBP | Project Overview
We are looking for an experienced full-stack web developer to assist with the development and refinement of a modern, responsive web platform.
The project involves building and improving user-facing website functionality, implementing responsive interfaces, integrating backend services and ensuring the final product delivers a smooth experience across desktop, tablet and mobile devices.
We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of modern web development practices who can take ownership of assigned development tasks and deliver clean, maintainable code.
This is an opportunity to work with a growing digital business, with the potential to establish a longer-term working relationship if the initial engagement is successful.
Scope of Work
The selected developer will be responsible for the following deliverables:
1. Frontend Development
* Develop modern, responsive website interfaces. * Implement designs using React or Next.js. * Ensure consistent layouts across desktop and mobile. * Build reusable components and maintainable frontend architecture. * Improve navigation, page transitions and user experience.
2. Backend Development
* Implement and maintain backend functionality. * Integrate APIs and external services. * Work with database structures and application logic. * Implement authentication and user account functionality where required. * Ensure reliable communication between frontend and backend services.
3. Performance & Optimisation
* Improve website loading performance. * Identify and resolve frontend and backend issues. * Ensure responsive behaviour across major browsers. * Apply appropriate security and development practices.
4. Testing & Delivery
* Test completed functionality. * Resolve identified bugs. * Provide documentation for implemented features. * Deliver source code and deployment instructions.
Preferred Technical Stack
We are particularly interested in developers with experience in:
* React.js * Next.js * TypeScript * JavaScript * Node.js * Supabase / PostgreSQL * REST APIs * Tailwind CSS * Git and GitHub * Cloud deployment environments
Experience with SaaS platforms, subscription systems, marketplaces or multi-user applications would be an advantage.
Project Requirements
The successful applicant should:
* Have demonstrable full-stack development experience. * Provide examples of previous websites or applications. * Be comfortable working from written specifications. * Communicate progress clearly throughout the engagement. * Be able to work independently and meet agreed milestones. * Produce clean, documented and maintainable code.
Proposed Milestones
Milestone 1 – Initial Assessment & Technical Planning
* Review the supplied requirements. * Confirm the proposed technical approach. * Identify dependencies and implementation stages.
Milestone 2 – Development
* Implement the agreed frontend and backend functionality. * Provide progress updates and a reviewable development version.
Milestone 3 – Testing & Refinement
* Test functionality and responsiveness. * Resolve agreed issues and outstanding bugs.
Milestone 4 – Final Delivery
* Supply completed source code. * Provide documentation and deployment instructions. * Complete final handover.
Milestone values and deadlines will be agreed before work begins.
When Applying
Please include the following in your proposal:
1. A short introduction and overview of your development experience. 2. Links to at least two previous projects. 3. Your experience with React, Next.js and backend development. 4. Your preferred development stack for this project. 5. Your estimated availability. 6. Your proposed fixed-price quotation or hourly rate. 7. An indication of whether you would be interested in further development engagements.
About the Business
We are developing a portfolio of digital products and services under Blackwellen Ltd.
Our development work is focused on modern web applications, SaaS products and digital platforms.
We value quality, clear communication and long-term professional relationships with reliable independent developers.
Platform & Project Management
We are also developing Gigvora, our freelance marketplace, to support professional collaboration between clients, freelancers and agencies.
Where appropriate, we use Gigvora to facilitate professional profiles, project discovery and freelancer engagement.
We look forward to reviewing your proposals.

item.title: Wellness Habit Blog Writing
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need a reliable writer who can create engaging health and lifestyle articles aimed at people looking for everyday wellness tips. Each post should leave readers with at least one practical habit they can begin that same day—no fluff, just clear, usable guidance supported by credible sources.
You’ll receive a topic or headline for every assignment. From there, I’d like 800-1,000 words crafted in a friendly, conversational tone, formatted for easy reading (sub-headings, short paragraphs, bullet points when it truly helps). Basic on-page SEO matters to me, so please weave in a primary keyword naturally, add an irresistible meta description, and suggest a title tag.
Deliverables for every article: • 1 Google-Doc or Word file with the final post • A brief list of cited studies or reputable references (hyperlinks are fine) • Title tag (≤60 characters) and meta description (≤155 characters)
I publish on WordPress, so familiarity with that platform is a plus, though not mandatory; clean, copy-ready text is the priority. If this fits your skill set, share one or two relevant samples that showcase your ability to teach practical wellness habits in a warm, engaging voice.

item.title: Local Construction SEO Boost
item.description:
30-250 AUD | I want to grow the volume of Google visitors landing on my local construction business website. The site already has a solid design, but search traffic is low and I’m not appearing in the local pack for key service-based searches. Your job is to diagnose what’s holding the site back and implement the improvements that will move the needle quickly and sustainably.
• First, I’ll give you full access to Google Search Console, Analytics, and the CMS so you can run a comprehensive audit—on-page content, technical structure, internal linking, page speed, and any local signals tied to Google Business Profile.
• From that audit, I expect a concise action plan that prioritises quick wins (meta data fixes, schema, crawl-error clean-up) and longer-term tasks such as location-focused content and authority building.
• Once we agree on the plan, you’ll carry out the on-page and technical optimisations yourself. For anything off-site—citations, backlinks—outline the strategy and handle the outreach or submissions where possible.
Acceptance criteria: measurable traffic uplift in Search Console, improved ranking visibility for our core construction services within the target service area, and a clear report detailing every change you made so I can track progress going forward.
If you’re comfortable working directly in WordPress, using tools like Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Google Business Profile Manager, and can communicate findings in plain language, let’s get started. You'll do all my smo to wordpress fixing. What ever is required. Continues monthly.

item.title: Sourdough Bakery Site
item.description:
30-250 USD | Website Design & Development for Artisan Sourdough Bakery
Project: Sourdough Clouds Bakery — Grass Valley, California
We are looking for a creative, experienced web designer/developer to build a beautiful, professional, mobile-friendly website for our artisan sourdough bakery.
We want something unique, warm, inviting, and easy to navigate — not a generic bakery template.
Our bakery specializes in naturally fermented artisan sourdough bread, specialty loaves, focaccia, challah, cookies, and other baked goods.
1. Website Concept & Design
Our website should be inspired by the journey of sourdough bread, from a living starter to a finished loaf.
We have an existing watercolor-style illustration showing the stages of sourdough bread making. We want to use this illustration as inspiration for the website's overall design, colors, graphics, and navigation.
The design should feel:
- Artisan, handcrafted, warm, and welcoming - Natural, rustic, and elegant - Inspired by watercolor illustrations, wheat, flour, dough, and freshly baked bread - Professional, clean, and easy to navigate - Beautiful on both desktop and mobile devices
We do not want complicated animations or a website that forces visitors through the bread-making process. Customers should be able to navigate directly to any section.
2. Unique Website Navigation — Very Important
Instead of traditional navigation buttons such as "About Us," "Our Story," and "Products," we want the main navigation to follow the stages of sourdough bread making.
Proposed navigation:
STARTER → MIX → RISE → BAKE → ENJOY
Each navigation button represents a regular website section:
STARTER — Our Story
- Introduction to Sourdough Clouds Bakery - Who we are and how our bakery began - Our passion for traditional sourdough baking - Our values and philosophy
MIX — Our Bakery & Ingredients
- What makes our bakery special - Our approach to quality ingredients - Naturally fermented sourdough - Simple ingredients and traditional baking methods - Information about our bakery and what we offer
RISE — Our Process
- A dedicated page explaining our complete sourdough-making process - Mixing, folding, bulk fermentation, shaping, overnight cold fermentation, scoring, baking, and cooling - Illustrations and photographs showing the different stages - Explaining why our bread takes time and what makes the process special
BAKE — Our Bread & Cookies
- Full product menu with beautiful photographs - Traditional artisan sourdough loaves - Specialty savory and sweet sourdough - Sandwich loaves - Focaccia - Challah - Cookies and other bakery products - Product descriptions, prices, and available options
ENJOY — Visit & Contact
- Bakery location and address - Opening hours - Google Maps integration - Contact information - Social media links - Information about ordering and pickup
We would like small illustrations or design elements connecting each navigation section to its corresponding stage of bread making.
The navigation should be creative but intuitive, with clear subtitles or descriptions when necessary.
3. Online Ordering System
This is an important part of the website.
Customers should be able to:
- Browse our bakery products with photos and prices - Select products and quantities - Choose available bread varieties and flavors - Customize certain products with optional ingredients/add-ons and additional charges - Add multiple products to a shopping cart - Choose an available pickup date/time - Enter their contact information - Submit orders and receive an order confirmation
We would prefer online payment capability through a secure payment provider, such as Stripe or Square, with the possibility of enabling payment at pickup.
The bakery owner must be able to:
- Add, edit, or remove products - Update prices and product descriptions - Add new seasonal flavors - Change product availability - Manage pickup dates and ordering deadlines - Receive and manage customer orders - Mark products as sold out
The ordering system should be straightforward and easy for customers to use.
4. Additional Website Requirements
- Fully responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop - Fast loading and good performance - Basic search engine optimization (SEO) - Google Maps integration - Instagram and Facebook links - Contact form - Easy-to-use administration dashboard - Secure website with SSL - Ability to update text, photographs, products, and prices without programming knowledge - Basic training or instructions for managing the website - All website administrator credentials and ownership transferred to us upon completion
5. Platform & Development
We are open to WordPress/WooCommerce or another affordable, reliable platform.
We prefer a solution that:
- Is inexpensive to maintain - Does not require a developer for everyday updates - Can grow with our bakery - Avoids unnecessary monthly subscriptions - Uses existing reliable tools/plugins where appropriate rather than expensive custom programming
We can provide our logo, existing artwork, bakery information, and product photographs.
6. What We Expect From the Developer
Please include the following in your proposal:
1. Your total fixed price for the complete website. 2. Examples of similar websites you have built, especially bakery, restaurant, or e-commerce websites. 3. Which platform you recommend and why. 4. Whether the online ordering system is included in your quote. 5. Estimated completion time. 6. Number of design revisions included. 7. Any additional costs, including plugins, hosting, or subscriptions. 8. Whether you provide support after launch.
We are looking for a creative, affordable developer who can bring our concept to life while keeping the website simple to operate and maintain.
Our goal is a beautiful bakery website that tells our story, showcases our products, explains the care behind our sourdough, and makes ordering easy for our customers.
